Author: Jasmine
Name: Blitzball Companion
Punchline: Follows a live game of Blitzball, for players, refs and announcers.
Description: Reads a Blitzball match out of Yell chat and follows it against the rules: phases, rounds, score, possession, and where every player is standing. Shows the sphere on a field view and over the arena itself, with each player's declared action and their roll. Flags anything that does not match the rules, and leaves the call to the referees.
